items.title: Nike stock hits 12-year low as turnaround skepticism lingers
items.summary: Yahoo Finance's Brooke DiPalma breaks down Nike's (NKE) stock drop to a multi-year low around $39 per share as weakness in North America, direct-to-consumer, and international segments fueling Wall Street skepticism over CEO Elliott Hill's long-term turnaround plan.

items.title: Nike Just Hit a 12-Year Low. Is the Bottom Near?

items.title: Goldman Sachs Stands Out, Nike Falls Flat. Best and Worst Dow Charts.
items.summary: Goldman Sachs, a premier global financial-services firm, has gained 44% over the past year. Nike, meanwhile, is down 50%.

items.title: Nike stock hits 12-year low as JPMorgan downgrades shares
items.summary: JPMorgan cut Nike to Underweight on Monday as a disappointing sales report from rival On Holding added pressure to the athletic footwear sector

items.title: Nike Stock Hits Lowest Level Since 2014 as Turnaround Drags On

items.title: Nike Keeps Tanking: One Pro Expects 85% Returns Moving Forward
items.summary: Nike has shed nearly half its value in a year while executives quietly sold millions in shares, yet one analyst team is holding a price target that would make the stock the biggest winner in its peer group. The gap between that call and reality raises a question worth answering.
